attributes.description: Deep infrastructure monitoring for Supabase nodes — CPU, memory, disk I/O, filesystem, network, and VM stats via OpenTelemetry.

embeddableConfig.content:
### 🖥️ Node & Infrastructure

Deep infrastructure monitoring for Supabase nodes. This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of the underlying host-level resources powering your Supabase deployment:

- **💾 Memory** - Total, active, cached, dirty, slab, and mapped memory usage over time
- **🌐 Network** - Receive/transmit throughput, packet rates, errors, and drops per interface
- **⚙️ CPU** - Overall utilisation %, per-core breakdown, CPU mode distribution (user, system, idle, iowait), and guest seconds
- **💿 Disk I/O** - Read/write bytes, completed operations, I/O time, discard activity, and merged operations
- **📁 Filesystem** - Free bytes, inode usage, per-device and per-mountpoint breakdown, and read-only status

TS metrics-supabase.metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Idle Rate` = AVG(RATE(node_cpu_seconds_total)) BY `Mode` = attributes.mode
| WHERE `Mode` == "idle"
| EVAL `CPU Utilisation %` = CASE(
    `Idle Rate` IS NULL, NULL,
    `Idle Rate` >= 1, 0.0,
    `Idle Rate` <= 0, 100.0,
    ROUND((1 - `Idle Rate`) * 100, 1)
  )
| KEEP `CPU Utilisation %`

query.esql:
TS metrics-supabase.metrics.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.mode IN ("user", "system", "idle", "iowait")
| WHERE `metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Average Node CPU Seconds by Mode (user, system, idle, iowait)` = SUM(RATE(`metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Mode` = attributes.mode
| SORT `Time` ASC, `Mode` ASC
